variants.name: 01-minimal
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished portrait mobile UI screenshot, 390:844 proportions, edge-to-edge screen without physical phone frame, no collage. Redesign Socially's "Share your QR" popup screen. Reference images show the existing app's visual language: icy powder blue, cool nearly-white surfaces, dark navy ink, soft frosted cards with thin white borders, 24-32px corner radii, Cormorant Garamond editorial serif headings and clean Inter utility text. Keep faithful to this palette and aesthetic. Design must be buildable, exceptionally well spaced, readable, premium, uncluttered. Show status bar, top title "Share your QR" and circular close X. Main content is one clearly defined shareable branded card, containing small SOCIALLY wordmark, a Solana network badge, headline "Receive on Solana", large crisp navy-on-white illustrative QR with generous white quiet zone (mockup only), wallet address label and sample address "7xK9…mP4q", and small "Only send assets on Solana". Below preview, outside card: helper "Only the card is shared", primary navy pill "Share image" with share icon, secondary "Save image" control. Keep everything visible above bottom safe area. No balances, no invented financial metrics, no generic purple, no neon, no 3D decoration. References are visual style sources, not edit targets. Direction 1 — Minimal editorial. Very light blue full-screen background. Spacious centered white card with thin pale blue outline, small navy brand row, elegant serif headline, simple large square QR, tidy address strip. Subtle compass watermark in upper-right of card, nearly invisible. Bottom primary share button full width with outlined save control. Strong typographic hierarchy. Refined and closest to the wallet reference.
